content: बाहुः [बाध् कु धस्य हः <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 The arm; शान्तमिदमाश्रमपदं स्फुरति च बाहुः कुतह् फलमिहास्य <ls>Ś. 1. 16</ls>; so महाबाहुः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The fore-arm. .²3 The fore-foot of an animal. .²4 A door-post. .²5 The base of a right-angled triangle (in <ab>geom.</ab>). .²6 (In <ab>medic.</ab>) The whole upper extremity of the body (<ab>opp.</ab> सक्थि). .²8 The bar of a chariot-pole. .²9 The shadow of the gnomon on a sun-dial. .²10 The arm as a measure of length (= 12 Aṅgulas). .²11 The limb of a bow. .{@-हू@} (<ab>du.</ab>) The lunar mansion Ārdrā.
